adql_query: SELECT source_id, ra, ra_error, dec, dec_error, parallax, parallax_error, pmra, pmra_error, pmdec, pmdec_error, radial_velocity, radial_velocity_error, ref_epoch, ra_dec_corr, ra_parallax_corr, ra_pmra_corr, ra_pmdec_corr, dec_parallax_corr, dec_pmra_corr, dec_pmdec_corr, parallax_pmra_corr, parallax_pmdec_corr, pmra_pmdec_corr, duplicated_source, phot_g_mean_mag, ruwe, astrometric_params_solved FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source WHERE parallax IS NOT NULL AND parallax > 20.000000 AND parallax_error > 0 AND parallax / parallax_error >= 10.000000 ORDER BY parallax DESC
data_honesty: Every fixture in THIS gate is SYNTHETIC or LITERATURE_FROM_MEMORY and is tagged as such, by design: closed-form fixtures verify the machinery because their expected answers are exact. This gate therefore makes no claim of agreement with Gaia DR3. That claim belongs to the separate C0-REAL-CATALOGUE gate, which reads the committed real snapshots under snapshots/.
database_format: portable versioned text snapshot; SQLite deferred as a dependency decision, materialised by tools/snapshot_to_sqlite.py
propagation_model: rectilinear barycentric, a LOCAL KINEMATIC model, not a Galactic orbit integrator; validity 1e5 yr
